summary: Lotus Technology Inc. filed a 6-K reporting a convertible note purchase agreement with Geely International (Hong Kong) Limited. The company will issue a $128.3 million senior convertible note via private placement, expected to close in June 2026. The note matures in 364 days, bears interest at SOFR + 3.35%, and is convertible into ordinary shares or ADSs at the volume-weighted average price over the 10 days before conversion. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The transaction is a form of capital raising, structured as debt with conversion optionality, ranking senior to unsecured debt. Watch for dilution upon conversion and the use of proceeds.
